text:
anika: Quick check — ACMEHealth private cutover is this Thurs 03/19. We need final signoff on firewall rules, cert rotation window, and air-gapped image transfer. Who's owning each?

liam: I'll own firewall + cloud router config. I have draft rules in the ticket.

sara: I'll own cert rotation and KMS access. Need ETA on when they'll provide KMS policies.

maya: I can handle the air-gap bundle transfer + validation. Asking ops for checksum verification step.

jonah: Quick FYI — staging pass 2 shows 1 failing e2e related to external metrics export blocked by firewall. Need to permit 10.2.0.0/16:9200 (metrics).

anika: Noted — @liam please add that. Also we need a canary window: 20 min, rollback triggers: >5% error or >200ms p95.

liam: Adding rule. Proposed firewall snippet:
```yaml
allow:
  - cidr: 10.2.0.0/16
    ports: [9200]
  - cidr: 172.20.0.0/24
    ports: [443]
```

sara: For KMS: customer provided IAM role arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ACME-KMS-Operator — we need to confirm they added sts:AssumeRole.

maya: Air-gap steps I need from ops:
1) sftp endpoint
2) checksum file
3) order of images (runtime, runtime-deps, models)
I'll run `sha256sum` locally and push results.

jonah: CI PR #4588 fixes the metrics export; @anika please merge after firewall rule lands so CI can re-run.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — outage window reserved Thu 03/19 02:00-03:00 UTC. Add to calendar? :calendar:

anika: I'm adding owners to the ticket. Final blockers list:
- Firewall rule for metrics (liam)
- KMS role confirmation (sara)
- Air-gap checksum & endpoint (maya)
- Merge PR #4588 and run staging smoke (jonah)
If we close these by Wed EOD, we're good.

liam: :thumbsup: will post the final rule to infra repo and ping ops on Slack. PR to follow.

sara: I pinged customer security this morning, awaiting confirmation of AssumeRole. ETA Wed 11:00 PST.

maya: Ops confirmed SFTP: sftp.acme.internal:2222 — will start transfer Wed 16:00 UTC, need ops to open egress from transfer host.

jonah: I'll re-run the staging e2e after merge and report timings. If p95 stays under 180ms we're set.

anika: Thanks team. Quick ask — any red flags on rollback automation? we need to ensure fallback to hosted model if private version fails.

liam: Rollback hook is in place; it flips routing via traffic-manager and reduces desired replicas to 0 for nodes in the VPC pool. I'll add a test run to the staging playbook.

sara: Cert rotation: schedule set to Thu 03/19 02:15 UTC during outage. Will coordinate with ops.

anika: Great. I'll update the executive checklist and mark owners. Ping here if anything slips. :rocket:
